purpose: One row per candidate source awaiting an artifact-level human rights decision. This artifact records rights review only. It contains no claim-to-source mapping and creates no citation validation, technical review, instructional review, approval, or eligibility change.
invariants: Rights decisions require a real reviewer identity and timestamp. Never synthesise or auto-promote a reviewer.
Each source is reviewed on its own exact artifact; presence in this file is not clearance.
Candidate classifications in the discovery manifest are candidates, never decisions, and are not promoted by this file.
Rights review alone does not authorize claim-to-source mapping; mapping is a separate branch and a separate gate.
No question payload, excerpt, or proprietary text may be stored from this review.
rights_classification_note: Clearance is scope-specific: a narrower cleared value never implies a broader one, and no value other than pending may be recorded until a named human reviewer records reviewer_identity and reviewed_at for that exact artifact. Rights classification is separate from evidence suitability, citation validation, technical review, instructional review, approval, and eligibility.

reviews.scope_of_clearance: Textual portions of DA PAM 750-33 attributable to the United States Department of the Army may be quoted, excerpted, and cited from the verified hashed artifact as a U.S. Government work. This clearance does not extend to photographs, illustrations, diagrams, manufacturer-originated material, contractor material, or other separately sourced components whose authorship or rights provenance has not been established. It does not authorize treating the complete scanned artifact as wholly cleared for commercial republication, unrestricted full-text reuse, or RAG ingestion.
reviews.review_notes: Human review approved by Rafael Rodriguez Jr. DA PAM 750-33 is an official Department of the Army publication and the verified artifact is the stable Internet Archive scan with SHA-256 cbcac329d964a20087cc879db73f758e64a70f620afb94d0a7b8234f0934edd1. The decision is intentionally limited to attributed textual excerpts because federal publication status does not independently establish the rights provenance of every embedded photograph, diagram, manufacturer-originated item, contractor contribution, or other third-party component. This rights decision does not constitute claim mapping, citation validation, technical review, instructional review, question approval, or assessment eligibility.

reviews.scope_of_clearance: Authoritative-source linking and factual citation to DOE-HDBK-1084-95, including section/page locators. This clearance does not authorize full-text storage, reproduction, RAG ingestion, model training, derivative-content rights, or commercial republication.
reviews.review_notes: Human review approved by Rafael Rodriguez Jr. DOE-HDBK-1084-95 is an official U.S. Department of Energy handbook and carries Distribution Statement A: approved for public release; distribution is unlimited. Because public release and federal provenance do not by themselves establish unrestricted reuse rights for every incorporated component, this review intentionally grants only link-and-citation clearance. No broader reuse permission is inferred.

reviews.scope_of_clearance: The verified authoritative Pressbooks artifact may be retained, stored, copied, redistributed, excerpted, indexed for retrieval/RAG, adapted, and used commercially under CC BY 4.0, provided appropriate attribution is maintained, the CC BY 4.0 license is identified, modifications are indicated where applicable, and no endorsement is implied. Material specifically marked with a different rights notice is excluded from this clearance and requires separate review.
reviews.review_notes: Human review approved by Rafael Rodriguez Jr. The authoritative BCcampus Pressbooks edition of Trigonometry and Single Phase AC Generation for Electricians by Chad Flinn states that the work is licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International except where otherwise noted. The publisher states that the book may be retained, reused, copied, redistributed, and revised with attribution. This decision applies only to material governed by the stated CC BY 4.0 license; separately marked third-party material is excluded.

reviews.scope_of_clearance: The canonical Workforce LibreTexts page may be linked to and cited as a CC BY 4.0 source authored by Peter Maokosy for Coalinga College. The page-level license ordinarily permits broader reuse, including commercial reuse and adaptation, but this review does not authorize stored excerpts, full-text storage, RAG ingestion, or other content-dependent reuse because no byte-stable artifact of record has been obtained. Broader clearance may be reconsidered after a reproducible artifact is captured and hashed.
reviews.review_notes: Human review approved by Rafael Rodriguez Jr. The Coalinga College Workforce LibreTexts page identifies Peter Maokosy as author and states a CC BY 4.0 license. Automated capture remediation could not obtain a byte-stable HTML or PDF artifact: repeated exports produced differing hashes. This decision therefore records only link-and-citation clearance and deliberately leaves artifact_sha256 null under the validator's narrow-scope allowance. This rights decision does not constitute claim mapping, citation validation, technical review, instructional review, question approval, or assessment eligibility.

reviews.scope_of_clearance: The exact Frontiers publisher-page artifact for DOI 10.3389/fmech.2022.1090152 may be retained, stored, copied, excerpted, redistributed, adapted, indexed for retrieval/RAG, and used commercially under CC BY 4.0, provided appropriate attribution is maintained, the original publication is cited, the CC BY 4.0 license is identified, changes are indicated where applicable, and no endorsement is implied. Separately credited or third-party material is excluded from this clearance and requires separate review when its rights status is uncertain.

This slice-level decision is bound to the stable exact-source HTML publisher artifact with SHA-256 9a0764fb555fb8676390325c61b4a98667b12de42d59768c475149b184096036. A prior registry decision exists for a different PDF representation of the same DOI; that earlier artifact hash is not reused here. This rights decision does not constitute claim mapping, citation validation, technical review, instructional review, chunk approval, question approval, or assessment eligibility.

required_before_any_decision: Capture the candidate artifact, record its SHA-256, and confirm the canonical identity and revision of that exact artifact.
A named human reviewer records reviewer_identity, reviewed_at, decided_rights_classification, scope_of_clearance and review_notes for that artifact only.
Unclear or conflicting reuse rights keep the source candidate-only; they are not approved evidence.
Update the validator in the same change that records the first real decision so the decided-state contract is explicit and fail-closed.
Rights review does not authorize claim-to-source mapping; open a separate branch for mapping after the rights decisions are recorded.
